
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/chaoguo1234/p/19888978" title="发布于 2026-04-18 20:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">UIImageView 设置图片不生效的原因排查</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        UIImageView 设置图片不生效的原因排查
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>最近在项目中碰到了一个<code>UIImageView</code>的问题。</p>
<p>需求内容是无论是在浅色还是深色模式，<code>UIImageView</code>都使用深色模式下的图片。</p>
<p>最先想到的方法就是从<code>Image Assets</code>中按照下面方法取出对应的深色模式图片，然后赋值给<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>image</code>属性:</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/489427/202604/489427-20260418203026708-1284822259.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code class="language-swift">var darkTrait = UITraitCollection(userInterfaceStyle: .dark)
// 取出暗黑模式下图片
let image = UIImage(named: name, in: nil, compatibleWith: darkTrait)
imageView.image = image
</code></pre>
<p>但是在浅色模式下，<code>UIImageView</code>还是显示浅色模式下的图片。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">// 打印 image
(lldb) po imageView.image
▿ Optional&lt;UIImage&gt;
  - some : &lt;UIImage:0x30ac59cc0 named(main: BDPPersonalPage_video_collection) {16, 16} renderingMode=automatic(original)&gt;
  
// 打印 image 的 configuration
(lldb) expression -l objc -O -- [0x30ac59cc0 configuration]
0x0000000301439a00

// 打印 configuration 的内容
(lldb) expression -l objc -O -- 0x0000000301439a00
&lt;UIImageConfiguration:0x301439a00 traits=(UserInterfaceIdiom = Pad, DisplayScale = 2, DisplayGamut = P3, HorizontalSizeClass = Regular, VerticalSizeClass = Regular, UserInterfaceStyle = Light, UserInterfaceLayoutDirection = LTR, PreferredContentSizeCategory = L, AccessibilityContrast = Normal)&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>从上面<code>imageView.image</code>的<code>configuration</code>属性输出可以看到，图片的<code>UserInterfaceStyle</code>还是<code>Light</code>。</p>
<p>通过调试<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>setImage:</code>方法，发现内部会调用下面的方法:</p>
<pre><code class="language-objectivec">-[UIImageView _resolveImagesWithPreviouslyDisplayedImage:]:
</code></pre>
<p><code>_resolveImagesWithPreviouslyDisplayedImage:</code>方法会获取<code>UIImageView</code>当前的<code>traitCollection</code>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">0x19b688834 &lt;+108&gt;: bl     0x199d49170 ; -[UIImageView _effectiveImageViewTraitCollectionForResolvingImages]
</code></pre>
<p>在<code>lldb</code>输出可以看到，<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>UserInterfaceStyle</code>是<code>Light</code>:</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">(lldb) po $x0
&lt;UITraitCollection: 0x17c7fa1c0; UserInterfaceIdiom = Pad, DisplayScale = 2, DisplayGamut = P3, HorizontalSizeClass = Regular, VerticalSizeClass = Regular, UserInterfaceStyle = Light, UserInterfaceLayoutDirection = LTR, ForceTouchCapability = Unavailable, PreferredContentSizeCategory = L, AccessibilityContrast = Normal, UserInterfaceLevel = Base, HDRHeadroomUsageLimit = 1, SceneCaptureState = 0, ImageDynamicRange = 1&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>接着会比较<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>traitCollection</code>和要设置的图片的<code>traitCollection</code>是否相等:</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">0x19b68884c &lt;+132&gt;: bl     0x19ad03818  ; -[UITraitCollection _isEqualToTraitCollectionForResolvingImage:]
</code></pre>
<p>只有两者相等，设置的图片才生效。</p>
<p>这里由于<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>UserInterfaceStyle</code>为<code>Light</code>，而要设置的图片的<code>UserInterfaceStyle</code>为<code>Dark</code>，因此二者不相等。</p>
<p>在二者不相等的情况下，<code>UIImageView</code>会使用自己的<code>traitCollection</code>从<code>Image Assets</code>中找对应的图片:</p>
<pre><code class="language-c"> 0x19b68898c &lt;+452&gt;: bl     0x19b68858c  ; -[UIImageView _resolvedImageFromImage:withImageViewTrait:]
</code></pre>
<p>由于<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>UserInterfaceStyle</code>是<code>Light</code>，因此找到的也是<code>Light</code>图片。</p>
<p>最后<code>UIImageView</code>会将找到的图片设置为真正要显示的图片。</p>
<p>这就是为什么使用暗黑模式的图片设置<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>image</code>属性不成功的原因。</p>
<p>知道了原因，想要解决，就只需要将保证<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>UserInterfaceStyle</code>和要设置的图片一样即可。</p>
<pre><code class="language-swift">imageView.overrideUserInterfaceStyle = .dark
</code></pre>
<p>加上上面代码，<code>UIImageView</code>就可以正常显示暗黑模式的图片了。</p>
<p>实际上，设置了<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>overrideUserInterfaceStyle</code>属性为<code>dark</code>，即使不设置<code>UIImageView</code>的<code>image</code>属性为暗黑模式图片，系统也会自动切换到暗黑模式图片。</p>


</div>
